name: add_cube
description: Add a cube to the model. Coordinates are in Blockbench units. Cubes support `rotation` (degrees) and `inflate` (round/shrink without moving) — use them; flat axis-aligned boxes look robotic. For compound multi-axis angles, parent the cube to a rotated group instead. For anything with a left and a right: the model faces -Z, so its OWN right is +X — pass `side` and the tool will enforce it. Prefer add_cubes to build many cubes at once. Returns the created cube with uuid and resolved face UVs (paint onto those with paint_faces).

box_uv.description: Use box UV (default follows the format).

faces.description: Optional per-face setup, keyed by north/south/east/west/up/down. Each: {uv:[x1,y1,x2,y2], rotation, texture: name|uuid}.

inflate.description: Inflate (+) or shrink (-) all faces in place — use for rounding/taper.

parent.description: uuid or name of the parent group.

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees [x,y,z]. Single-axis is most reliable per cube.

side.description: The MODEL's own side. Appends the _left/_right suffix and REJECTS the call if the cube is on the other side. The model faces -Z, so its right is +X (a front-view render shows this mirrored).
